name: Fanta Hedlund-Diarra
role: Personal security and threat neutralization — bodyguard
location: The Rookery — dense vertical housing, gang-controlled, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Fanta Hedlund-Diarra are compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground like something designed to survive impacts. At 34, their face is memorable in a profession that rewards forgettability, and they have learned to compensate. The chrome is visible — wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation — and they make no effort to hide it.

Before the runner life, they worked corporate — low-tier security, the kind that teaches you exactly how the system's defenses fail. They work as a bodyguard out of The Rookery, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

In the runner community, Fanta Hedlund-Diarra are known for getting the job done and not asking questions that would make the job harder to stomach.

core_fears: Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of Meridian 88
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
coping_mechanisms: Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
blind_spots: Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
psychology.secret: Fanta Hedlund-Diarra can't read. Hides it behind voice interfaces and memorization. The shame is older than the chrome.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and personable on the surface, with an undertone that suggests the warmth is a professional tool.
speech_patterns.cadence: Staccato bursts separated by calculating silences.
verbal_tics: Repeats the last thing someone said back to them before responding — processing or intimidation
Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
example_lines: "You're paying me to be the thing between you and everything else. Stay behind me."
"I don't protect people I don't respect. Lucky for you, I respect your money."
"The threat you see isn't the one that kills you. Watch my eyes, not my hands."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Fanta Hedlund-Diarra's reputation — and a price for silence
A corporate black site Fanta Hedlund-Diarra once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know their face
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Fanta Hedlund-Diarra owes a personal debt to
narrative_function: As a bodyguard, Fanta Hedlund-Diarra embodies the tension between independence and isolation. They are a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation. Bone lacing — titanium mesh throughout skeleton, increases durability and striking power
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.
affiliation: Independent — maintains network of professional contacts

weaknesses: trust issues that limit crew effectiveness
old injury that flares under specific conditions

decision_rules: Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
breaking_points: A child being put in danger as leverage against them
Learning that a job they completed resulted in mass casualties they weren't told about
